name: BG1EE Modded
description: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition snapshot pack

notes.title: Siege of Dragonspear
notes.body: If the source install is DLC-merged, the target must have the same DLC Merger base preparation applied first. The pack records that requirement and refuses to mix with unrelated WeiDU installs.

notes.title: EET
notes.body: EET installs on top of BG2EE and is not supported by snapshot mode.
